name: Wonders Information Co., Ltd
summary: Wonders Information Co., Ltd operates as a prominent provider of smart city software and associated services throughout China. The company specializes in developing and implementing intelligent solutions for a wide range of public sectors. These include healthcare, smart government administration, market regulation, social security and welfare, urban safety, and smart education. Beyond specific sectoral applications, it also undertakes the construction and ongoing management of overarching smart city public platforms. Wonders Information's technological capabilities span across various advanced domains. It provides comprehensive Information and Communication Technology (ICT) and Information Technology (IT) services, encompassing system integration, operation and maintenance, consulting, security, and value-added services. Its portfolio further includes cloud-based solutions like data centers and management platforms, cloud service buses, unified payment platforms, and offerings in digital park management and network security. The company also harnesses cutting-edge technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), and big data analytics for its clients. A significant asset of the company is its extensive intellectual property portfolio, comprising approximately 1,300 software products and associated copyrights. Established in 1995, Wonders Information maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
